maria.label: Meet the Designer
maria.name: Maria Capor
maria.p1: I create homes with feeling, personality and warmth. My work is rooted in a love of beautiful interiors, thoughtful details and spaces that feel as good as they look.
maria.p2: Through <bold>Home By Nox</bold>, I help clients transform their homes with considered interior design guidance, whether they are refreshing a single room, rethinking a layout or creating a more cohesive home.
maria.p3: My world also includes Villa V, a private Mediterranean retreat in Croatia, designed and created together with my husband. Across both interiors and Villa V, the feeling is the same: relaxed beauty, soulful design and spaces made to be lived in.

quote.text: "May your walls know joy, may every room hold laughter and every window open to great possibility."

philosophy.label: The Studio
philosophy.heading: Maria Capor's Philosophy
philosophy.p1: Whether you are refreshing a single room or creating a home from scratch, I am here to guide you through every step. My work begins with really listening and understanding your home, your life and how you want your spaces to feel.
philosophy.p2: From there, I put together a complete interior design proposal built entirely around your wishes. We go through it together, and if anything needs refining, we adjust until it feels right. I care about finding the best solution for you and your home, and I am with you throughout the whole process.
philosophy.quote: "...because life's too short for boring interiors."

step1.title: Let's Talk
step1.body: We begin with a conversation about your home, your ideas and how you'd like your space to feel. Whether you have a clear vision or don't know where to start, we'll find the right direction together.

step2.title: Your Design Proposal
step2.body: Based on our discussions, I create a complete interior design proposal tailored to your home and lifestyle. This may include layouts, furniture suggestions, colours, lighting and materials.

step3.title: Refine and Create
step3.body: We review the proposal together and make any adjustments needed. My goal is always to create a home that feels personal, functional and truly yours.

hero.label: Exclusive Destination
hero.title: Villa V
hero.subtitle: A timeless sanctuary perched above the Adriatic, where ancient stone meets modern coastal luxury.

story.label: The Villa
story.heading: Deeply Rooted in the Adriatic Coast
story.p1: Nestled in a breathtaking location, Villa V promises an unforgettable experience for those seeking something truly unparalleled.
story.p2: Step outside to discover your private oasis and immerse yourself in the tranquil ambiance as you gaze upon panoramic views of the beautiful Adriatic Sea. Bask in the warm sun on plush loungers, sip on a refreshing drink at the poolside, or take a rejuvenating dip in the crystal clear water of the infinity pool.
story.p3: As the day fades into evening, gather with loved ones for a memorable al fresco dining experience on the terrace, embracing the gentle breeze and the starry night. Whether you seek a romantic getaway, a family vacation, or a luxurious retreat with friends, Villa V is the epitome of refined living.

details.heading: Property Details
details.copy: Villa V is a very unique property created by myself and my husband, finalised in 2017. Situated in total privacy with exceptional views in a green zone surrounded by olive groves and the beautiful south Croatian landscape — yet just a 10-minute drive from Dubrovnik Airport and 15 minutes from the charming medieval village of Cavtat.

pool.title: Wellness & Pool
pool.body: Heated infinity pool and relaxation areas, including sunbeds, furniture and a cabana.

kitchen.title: Kitchen Facilities
kitchen.body: Large fully equipped kitchen, perfect for dining all day long.

location.title: Exclusive Location
location.body: Located in beautiful Cavtat, 25 minutes from Dubrovnik.

location.heading: A Hidden Peninsula
location.copy: Stay in a beautiful, secluded natural setting that is still close to the picturesque medieval village of Cavtat, with its lovely little marina lined by charming cafés and restaurants.

review1.text: There are no words that can do Villa V justice in all honesty. Paradise perhaps? I don't really want to write this review because I want to keep Villa V all to myself haha! The villa is more beautiful than words can describe... stunning location, a peaceful haven... utter perfection. The swimming pool, heated and utterly delicious with views to die for and a sunset your iPhone doesn't do justice. The grounds and gardens are equally spectacular. Inside the house is beyond stylish — I would love to meet someone who didn't want to live there, I don't think such a person exists! We actually had our wedding do at the villa having been married on the beach in Mlini and it has gone down in history as the best wedding ever. The truth is we didn't leave the villa much at all, because when you stay somewhere like this you don't want to waste a second away from it. See you next year! Love Lucy & Gray xxx
review1.author: Lucy & Gray, London, England

review2.text: Amazing amazing amazing!!!! The home is truly a home away from home. It looks exactly as it is on the pictures. The manager is friendly and very very helpful. The house was clean. We could easily have stayed our whole stay in the Villa and still have an amazing time. The view was breath taking!!! We will revisit again!
review2.author: Gladys, England

review3.text: This property is simply stunning. The house itself is a design masterpiece, but the outside of the back of the house is the true gem. It's as good as the pictures (or better) with incredible view of the sea, gorgeous infinity pool, cabana, large outdoor dining area with retractable shade, swing, etc. The location of the house is very convenient to the airport (15 min) and also for a day trip to Montenegro. However, you may not want to leave the house once you check-in, it is that stunning.
review3.author: Neal, Virginia, USA

review4.text: After making our reservation for Maria's home, we were expecting a nice house with a great view since the pictures on Airbnb are stunning. This said, they are nothing compared to the reality of the experience in this house. I've seen lots of beautiful homes but certainly not to the level of perfection of Maria's. The incredible location, less than 10 minutes from the airport but yet completely isolated from everything with no neighbors around. Just endless and beautiful views of the sea and green wild nature. Everything is beautifully designed and the quality is amazing. The beds are incredibly comfortable, better than any hotel. The pool is out of this world, and all the environment outside is a continuation of this perfection. Communication with Maria is easy, quick and efficient, and Vlaho who is the contact onsite is the best. If you're looking for a dream home for any type of relaxing vacation, Maria's home is for you.
review4.author: Benoit, New York, USA

intro.label: Customer Reviews
intro.heading: Homes Made to Be Lived In
intro.p1: I have worked on many different interior design assignments and styled many homes for sale. I am most passionate about helping people elevate the homes where they actually live.
intro.p2: Many times I have been told after styling a home for sale — now I wish I had stayed here, it turned out so well! And it is great fun, but it is even more fun when that feeling comes when you actually stay there.
intro.p3: The article alongside is an interview with me in SvD, 2020. Below, you can read a selection of customer reviews from some of my previous assignments.

reviews.text: Maria is empathetic, accommodating and professional. I felt completely safe in Maria's communication, feedback, advice, tips, suggestions and final styling. We had a continuous dialogue while she was working which was appreciated. I love coming home to myself and also get many compliments on how nice it is here at home.
reviews.author: Cia, Danderyd

reviews.text: I have experienced great responsiveness from Maria. She guided me through my somewhat confused ideas and found products that matched well with what I wanted. Maria was knowledgeable, professional and inspiring.
reviews.author: Mylaine, Södermalm

reviews.text: So wonderful to get help from a real professional! After several years, my thoughts and ideas finally came down on paper, with pictures and sketches that made it possible to understand exactly how it would turn out. Much better than I could have wished for!
reviews.author: Jenny, Stocksund

reviews.text: We have received such great interior design help from Maria with arranging the furniture at home. She has an exceptional eye for what works, things you can easily become completely blind to at home. She also comes with good tips on what you could renew. With her pleasant and accommodating manner, she is very pleasant to hire. We highly recommend her!
reviews.author: Helen, Danderyd

reviews.text: I can highly recommend Maria. She is very professional, has an incredible talent for seeing great solutions with existing furniture and is very good at finding furniture, lighting and interior design details that enhance the room.
reviews.author: Berrin, Stocksund

reviews.text: A thousand thanks to Maria who helped us come up with interior design ideas for several rooms spread over 3 floors. We have lived in the home for 10 years and had many ideas about how to change it as the children got older and our needs changed. Maria came up with comprehensive solutions where we could easily click on links to see furniture. We were amazed that the costs didn't skyrocket — a good mix of nice choices. We kept in touch with Maria throughout the project.
reviews.author: Marie-Louise, Enebyberg
